newsitem.title: USA: Barshefsky concerned by U.S.-Japan trade imbalance.
newsitem.headline: Barshefsky concerned by U.S.-Japan trade imbalance.

text.p: U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky said Wednesday that the United States was concerned about its trade imbalance with Japan and said that Washington did not wish to see the gap grow wider.
"We are concerned with some of the recent numbers we have seen from Japan," Barshefsky told reporters following a speech to an Economic Strategy Institute conference.

Barshefsky said the United States has taken that message to Japanese officials and that she expected it to be reinforced when President Clinton and Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto meet in Washington later this month.
"We do not wish to see an increase in Japan's trade surplus with the United States as it tries to move out of its current economic difficulties," Barshefsky told reporters.
